canonical_rule: Full compatible families use the base name; partial compatible components use explicit period names. Preserve all annual source identities, definitions and code meanings. Never merge by basename alone.
requirements: No overlapping nonnull values across source columns
Members have disjoint observed-year sets, enabling exact reconstruction
Every retained input value copied exactly
Input null and cleaning semantics unchanged
Canonical metadata preserves annual source identities and definitions
Code mappings retain annual meaning; no cross-year categorical recode inferred

The 2009 definition identifies the 2003 cohort at 4-year institutions and 2006 cohort at 2-year institutions; the 2010 definition identifies the 2004 cohort for both institution types. The 2010 cohort statement has not been verified against the original survey/source, so a metadata typo cannot be assumed. Retain all three source columns separately.
